claims.claim: Spoken / sighted The Needles 16 miles W of Needles (May 9 at 3:45 PM)
claims.citation: New York Herald, 23 May 1866, p. 11, col. 4
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Bremen (Brem), Neynaber, Bremen May 6 and
Southampton 9th, with mdse and 738 passengers, to Oelrichs
& Co. May 9, at 3:45 PM, passed steamship Teutonia (Ham),
16 miles W of Needles, bound E; 13th, 4:30 PM, lat 49 10, lon
25, passed a full rigged steamship of the Inman line, bound
E; 19th, lat 41 41, lon 57 35, passed bark Phebe Dunbar (Br),
bound W; 21st, lat 40 34, lon 70, passed bark Warren White,
bound to Boston.

claims.claim: Spoken / sighted Sandy Hook 233 miles of Sandy Hook (29th 10 a. m.)
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Etna (Br.), Tibbits, Liverpool April 14, Queenstown
16th, with mdse. and 733 pass. to John G. Dale. April 17th, 185 miles
W. of Fastnet, passed steamship Louisiana. 24th, lat. 43 50, lon. 45 08[?],
Br. bark Gooyer[?] Castle, bound W. 27th, lat. 41 33, lon. 61, 7:30 p. m.,
a steamer bound E., showing one blue light and one rocket. 29th, 10
a. m., 233[?] miles of Sandy Hook, passed steamships America, City of
